title: JevBench result packet
description: One measured JevBench attempt, smoke test, or official citation. The shape is based on the harness result packets and committed experiment summaries.

bench_id.description: Stable benchmark line identifier, for example LD-DG or CC-JEV.

run_id.description: Stable identifier for this attempt or smoke sample.

map.description: Game map/scenario label. Use null for a non-game benchmark.

status.description: Canonical outcome. A native victory/defeat is mapped to win/loss only when the benchmark success bar is verified.

jev_via.description: Decision backend or transport, such as typesafe, openrouter, or openjev. Use null for an official-only citation.

jev_model.description: Decision model identifier, when a model was run.

openjev_base_url.description: Non-secret OpenJev endpoint label, when applicable. Never include credentials, query-string keys, or bearer tokens.

guide_model.description: Guide model identifier, when a guide model was used.

memory_mode.description: Harness memory mode. Use null when the benchmark does not have a Jev memory setting.

calls.description: Number of decision calls made by the run.

wall_seconds.description: Measured wall-clock duration in seconds, or null when not measured.

hq_win_evidence.description: StarCraft II Liberation Day HQ-and-Raynor win evidence. Use null for non-Liberation-Day or non-game rows.

source.description: Provenance of the result: an independently run/smoked result or an official citation.

blocker.description: Actionable blocker explanation for blocked or incomplete attempts, otherwise null.

artifact_paths.description: Paths or labels for supporting artifacts; do not include secrets.

notes.description: Short human-readable context, caveats, or run notes.

cost_usd.description: Measured inference cost in USD, when available.

latency_median_ms.description: Median decision/inference latency in milliseconds, when available.

latency_p95_ms.description: P95 decision/inference latency in milliseconds, when available.

decision_median_ms.description: Median complete decision-cycle latency in milliseconds, when available.

decision_p95_ms.description: P95 complete decision-cycle latency in milliseconds, when available.

actions_submitted.description: Count of game actions accepted for submission, when applicable.

correct.description: Correct answers in a non-game or probe benchmark, when applicable.

total.description: Total scored answers in a non-game or probe benchmark, when applicable.

extensions.description: Domain-specific measurements or evidence. Keep common site fields at the top level and never place secrets here.
